name: Mild Murgh Makhani (Butter Chicken) & White Naan
whyItWorks: Turmeric, ginger, cumin, and fenugreek provide massive flavor and natural anti-inflammatory action without chili heat; white naan is pillow-soft.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order '0/10 spice / Mild / Kid-friendly.' At home, simmer chicken thighs in strained tomato puree, coconut milk or heavy cream/ghee, garam masala, and turmeric. Warm white naan in the toaster oven.
